label: Huiyang into Shenzhen
why: Huiyang (hya, one district of Huizhou, 0.96M plan) is 24th worst worldwide: 47% of its commutes cross its line, 250,000 a day of them to Shenzhen against 91,000 to Huizhou, its built-up area running on from Shenzhen's Longgang. hya is retired into Shenzhen's metro (shz). Huizhou's metro (hui), its own prefecture's, would fail pop_vs_fua (1.68) and its hull (0.60).
